title: Full Stack Developer
tagline: A beginner's path from HTML to React, Node.js, databases and basic DevOps, with a project at each step.

credit.text: Based on the Full Stack roadmap from roadmap.sh (personal use)

phases.title: HTML and CSS
phases.description: Structure and style pages, then prove it by building a few static webpages.

phases.title: JavaScript and npm
phases.description: Make pages interactive with JavaScript and start pulling in packages from npm.

phases.title: Git and GitHub
phases.description: Track your code with Git and collaborate with others on GitHub.

phases.title: Frontend apps
phases.description: Build real frontend apps with React and Tailwind CSS (fine to revisit after the backend).

phases.title: Node.js
phases.description: Start backend work with Node.js and write some command-line apps.

phases.title: Databases
phases.description: Store data in PostgreSQL and build simple create, read, update and delete apps.

phases.title: APIs, auth and caching
phases.description: Design REST APIs, add token-based auth and cache with Redis to finish a complete app.

phases.title: Linux and AWS deployment
phases.description: Learn enough Linux and core AWS services to put your app on a real server.

phases.title: Monitoring and CI/CD
phases.description: Keep an eye on your server and automate builds and deployments.

phases.title: Automation and infrastructure
phases.description: Configure servers with Ansible and describe your infrastructure with Terraform.
